property_summary: For any caller A and any newOwner address N, in the correct contract only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership(N) (non-owner calls revert), whereas the mutant inverts the check so non-owners can call transferOwnership and the real owner cannot — causing ownership to change under different callers.
change_summary: Invert onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT the owner, allowing anyone except owner to call owner-only functions (including transferOwnership), changing who can transfer ownership.
